crossRefs.note: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there…
The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings, and those…
He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty…
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

translations.web: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.
translations.bsb: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
translations.kjv: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.
translations.asv: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth, Even Jehovah upon many waters.
